context: A manager and assistant discuss a small-and-medium-enterprise restructuring
purpose: Teach: 中小/従業/掛け/ポスト/サラリーマン/適正/大半/にわたって

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 今回の中小企業の再編案、ちょっと相談したいんだ。
lines.en: About this SME restructuring proposal, I'd like to discuss it a bit.
lines.style: Manager opening, measured and consultative tone with subordinate.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、従業員の配置転換についてですよね?
lines.en: Yes, it's about the reassignment of employees, right?
lines.style: Polite assistant ですます register, confirming context attentively.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そう。数ヶ月にわたって検討してきたが、大半の部署を統合する方向で進めたい。
lines.en: Right. We've been reviewing it for several months, and want to merge most departments.
lines.style: Decisive manager summarizing long deliberation with firm direction.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ポストの数が減ると、社内でかなり動揺が広がりそうですが…
lines.en: If the number of positions decreases, considerable unrest will likely spread internally...
lines.style: Cautious assistant raising concern politely, trailing off respectfully.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: わかってる。だからこそ、適正な評価基準を先に作っておく必要があるんだ。
lines.en: I know. That's exactly why we need to establish fair evaluation criteria first.
lines.style: Manager acknowledging concern, pivoting to pragmatic next step.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 普通のサラリーマンにとっては、評価のやり方ひとつに人生が懸かっていますからね。
lines.en: For an ordinary salaryman, their whole life hinges on a single evaluation method.
lines.style: Thoughtful assistant offering empathetic perspective on employee stakes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: その通りだ。掛け声だけにならないよう、来週役員会に最終案を出す。資料を頼む。
lines.en: Exactly. To make sure it doesn't end up as just empty slogans, I'll submit the final proposal to the board next week. Please prepare the materials.
lines.style: Manager closing with clear delegation and forward-looking deadline.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。今夜中にまとめて、明朝お持ちします。
lines.en: Understood. I'll compile it tonight and bring it to you tomorrow morning.
lines.style: Polite assistant accepting task with crisp professional commitment.
